narr: A mesoscale convective vortex moved across the Mid-South during the late afternoon and early evening on June 5, 2024. This feature interacted with a moist and unstable airmass to produce scattered thunderstorms across northeast Mississippi. Surface-based convective available potential energy values of 3000 J/kg and precipitable water values around 1.75 inches resulted in flash flooding, isolated damaging wind, and a weak tornado.
ev: Numerous roads were flooded in Tupelo and Saltillo including Beech Springs Road near Sweet Water Lane.
Thirteen homes were flooded in south Saltillo. A subdivision along Willow Creek Road and Birch Tree Lane had to be evacuated.
Several roads were flooded in and around Fulton, including West Lake Drive, Old Highway 25, and Peppertown Road.
